title: Three Little Angels
transcription:
Three Little Angels

Three little angels, all dressed in white,
trying to get to heaven on the end of a kite,
well the kite string broke, and down they fell,
instead of gettin' to heaven, they went to...

Two little angels, all dressed in white...

after one, begin again with:
Three little devils, all dressed in red,
trying to get to heaven on the end of a thread,
well the thread broke and down they fell,
instead of gettin' to heaven, they went to...

continue as before and switch to:
Three little staffers, all dressed in blue,
trying to get to heaven in a big war canoe,
well it got swamped, and down they fell,
instead of gettin' to heaven, they went to...

End with:
Don't get excited, don't loose your head,
instead of gettin' to heaven, they went to bed.
